name: Lanka Environment Fund Grants
summary: Rolling grants from a Conservation Collective foundation for local non-profits and community groups to run fieldwork, restoration, community engagement and other conservation projects; decided at quarterly committee meetings.

status.quote: Applications for funding will be accepted on a rolling basis. Decisions will be made at Steering Committee meetings which are held 4 times per year.

applicant_types.quote: Local non-profit organisations working towards environmental conservation are highly recommended to apply for grants. Associations, clubs, social cooperatives and other local community based organisations are encouraged to apply for grants.

access.quote: All applicants need to complete and submit our application form.

window.quote: Applications for funding will be accepted on a rolling basis.

geography.quote: supports existing conservation initiatives in Sri Lanka with their work by providing grant funding
